# Boxhill & Co.

> > Premium outdoor furniture and accessories featuring Ledge Lounger pool furniture, Italian terracotta planters, and commercial-grade patio collections made with high-density polyethylene and sustainable materials.

Boxhill & Co. (SHOPBOXHILL) specializes in luxury outdoor living products including in-pool loungers, dining sets, fire pits, and handcrafted planters. The company emphasizes USA-made products, eco-friendly materials like recycled polyethylene, and artisan pieces from Italy and South Africa for both residential and commercial applications.

## Key Topics

- Ledge Lounger in-pool furniture
- High-density polyethylene (HDPE) outdoor furniture
- Italian terracotta planters from Impruneta
- Commercial and residential patio furniture
- USA-made outdoor products
- Pool furniture and deck chairs
- Phenolic outdoor dining tables
- Dryfeel synthetic weave
- EZ Dri foam technology
- Eco-smart bioethanol fire pits
- Marine-grade outdoor fabrics
- Frost-proof terracotta
- Recycled and sustainable materials
- Adirondack chairs and rockers
- Custom outdoor furniture
